intents.title: Siri & Shortcuts
intents.description: Use Otopoly with Siri, from the Shortcuts app or from Spotlight. If your phone is set to English, say the English phrases.
intents.unavailable: Siri shortcuts aren't available in this build. They work in the iPhone app from the App Store or TestFlight.
intents.phrases_empty: With your permissions in this business, there are no shortcuts you can use.
intents.shortcut.todaySummary.title: Today's summary
intents.shortcut.todaySummary.hint: Without opening the app, tells you the cars in progress, ready and delivered, and today's collected payments (as of the app's last update).
intents.shortcut.newJob.title: New job
intents.shortcut.newJob.hint: Give a plate in Shortcuts and the customer and vehicle are picked for you.
intents.shortcut.searchPlate.title: Search plate
intents.shortcut.searchPlate.hint: Siri asks for the plate; a single match opens the customer.
intents.shortcut.openCustomer.title: Open customer
intents.shortcut.openCustomer.hint: Say the name or plate of a customer you served in the last 30 days.
intents.shortcut.readyJobs.title: Ready cars
intents.shortcut.readyJobs.hint: Opens today's cars that are ready for delivery.
intents.shortcut.askAssistant.title: Ask the assistant
intents.shortcut.askAssistant.hint: Siri takes your question and starts a new assistant chat.
intents.shortcut.qrLogin.title: Sign in with QR
intents.shortcut.qrLogin.hint: Opens the scanner to approve a web panel sign-in.
intents.shortcut.calendarToday.title: Today's calendar
intents.shortcut.calendarToday.hint: Opens the calendar on today's appointments.
intents.share_customers_hint: The names and plates of up to 40 customers you served in the last 30 days are kept for Siri on this device only. Phone numbers, e-mail addresses and balances are never shared.
intents.privacy: When you sign out or switch businesses, everything Siri can read and its suggestions are deleted.
intents.open_failed: The Shortcuts app couldn't be opened.
intents.denied: You don't have permission for this action.
